sceneObservations.qualification: Different guest boots and background conditions; reference includes a short noninvasive debugger snapshot. Both readbacks pass; these observations establish no rendering throughput gain.

continuousDragMeasurement.scope: A first immediate held-button move followed by a coalesced one. Confirms approximate eight-millisecond pacing, not end-to-end display latency.
